Current work

What I am building now, and two other design projects.

Team projectIn progress

Lunar rover, NASA RASC-AL 2027

TAMU ThinkTank Team Nova is designing an autonomous rover that locates, drills, and analyzes water ice near the lunar South Pole (Theme 3, Lunar Resource Exploration). I am on the rover body subteam, where I develop the chassis, wheels, and suspension and design the drilling claw.

  • The problem: weight became our hardest constraint.
  • The decision: we cut the number of sensors and made the software more intelligent to make up for the lost data.
  • My part: I helped test individual sensors to find the minimal combination that worked best with the system software.
  • The lesson: treat a limit as part of the design, and let test results settle the argument.
